newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's ICA to send waste to Merida.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's ICA to send waste to Merida.

text.p: Empresas ICA, Mexico's largest construction firm, said Monday it had reached a 180 million peso deal with the city of Merida in Yucatan state to deposit solid waste there.
"This concession will benefit 650,000 people and last 15 years," ICA said in a communique. "The value of these services exceed 180 million pesos."
The ICA subsidiary Tecnologiia Ambiental (Setasa) will operate the dump as it does others in the states of Tamaulipas and Nuevo Leon.
"Setasa has a total of 425 employees and has become a leading enterprise in providing this type of service for municipalities," ICA said.
